panel.title: Task settings & commands

setup.title: Connect your AgentRunner
setup.description: Choose your installation to get started. We’ll verify Runner and its managed Python before opening your workspace.
setup.changeHelp: Verify a location for new Runners. Open tabs keep their own installation and work context.

tabs.consequence: This stops this Runner and its owned processes, including active, suspended or uncertain work. Unsaved input in this tab will be discarded. Other Runner tabs stay open.
tabs.idleRequired: Middle-click requires a verified idle Runner. Use Close Tab inside this Runner to review and confirm termination.
tabs.unconfirmed: Native cleanup is unconfirmed. The tab was retained. Review the Runner error before closing again.

work.allocationHelp: Always create a new Runner by default. Reuse checks the exact visible Runner again before assignment.
work.legacyAccount: Saved account label “{{account}}” is unresolved. Select an exact agent / account identity.
work.promoted: Promoted {{name}} ({{id}}, order {{order}}) with its original process and control connection.
work.observing: {{name}} · submitted once; waiting for Runner admission and start evidence…
work.started: {{name}} · Runner verified start (event {{event}}). Full output is in its tab.
work.retained: Runner work: {{state}}. Ownership retained; do not resend. Continue in the owning Runner tab.
work.rejected: Instruction unsent or admission rejected: {{code}}. Draft retained.
work.unavailable: Authenticated work v1 is unavailable, busy or already owns unfinished work. Instruction was not resubmitted.

config.finalInspectFailed: Confirmed receipts were retained, but final inspection failed: {{diagnostic}}
config.planMismatch: The plan does not belong to these exact settings and Runner. Create a new plan.
config.optionsStale: Candidates changed during inspection. The entire list was discarded; explicitly refresh from the first page.
config.notIdle: Execution, recovery, suspension or retained authority prevents changes. Finish the official Runner flow first.
config.confirmation: Use the official context release / Brief discard flow in this Runner terminal, then inspect and plan again. Hub cannot approve it for you.
config.planHelp: Changes are sequential, not atomic. Existing work is preserved; execution settings affect the next run. Review each effect and explicitly choose Apply.
config.applied: Runner confirmed the configuration commits. This does not mean work has started.
config.partial: Some settings committed. Earlier successful receipts are preserved; no rollback was attempted.
config.ownerInspectUnavailable: Runner preserved commit receipts but its final internal inspection was unavailable.
config.verified: Final Runner inspection received. Only owner receipts establish this request’s commits.
config.finalUnavailable: Commit receipts preserved; final Runner inspection unavailable.
config.receiptUnknown: Completion is unconfirmed. Do not repeat this apply, even if a later value matches. Use the owning Runner terminal.
config.identityChanged: Runner or account identity is invalid or changed. Discard the list and inspect again.
config.requestFailed: Runner rejected or failed the request: {{code}}
config.legacyPages: This Runner cannot prove consistency across pages. Use terminal settings for incomplete selections.
config.draftChanged: The draft changed while checking. Inspect and create a new plan.
config.invalidCombination: The selection is not a verified identity/model/reasoning/tier combination, or Runner is busy. Review and inspect again.
config.stalePlan: Runner state changed or the plan is stale. Inspect and explicitly create a new plan.
config.unsupported: This Runner does not offer a supported session configuration API.
config.setupRequired: Account setup is still required before running work.
config.incomplete: A complete, consistent candidate list is unavailable. Refresh before selecting.
config.rootHelp: Choose an explicit absolute working directory for Direct modes. Runner validates access and Pure Direct policy during plan and apply.
config.defaults: Saved Hub defaults (separate from Runner settings)
config.defaultsUnresolved: Saved defaults lack a verified identity or combination: {{fields}}. Nothing was substituted.
config.title: Runner configuration
config.idle: Ready for an explicit inspection or plan.
config.inspecting: Reading actual settings and verifying all options…
config.catalog: Reading the destination account catalog without changing accounts…
config.planning: Checking the proposed changes with Runner…
config.closed: Runner session or native control connection closed.
config.queued: Queued by Runner; processing and success are unconfirmed.
config.interaction: Finish the existing interaction in this Runner terminal.
config.notSent: Confirmed not sent. No setting change was requested.
config.terminalHelp: Use this Runner’s existing /target, /account, /model or /run-mode terminal settings.

spare.timeout: Readiness or terminal input was not established within 40 seconds.

spare.cleanupFailed: Spare cleanup could not be confirmed: {{reason}}. Close and reopen Hub before preparing another spare.

references.inventoryIncomplete: Pending inventory is incomplete. Instruction unsent.
references.inventoryNoProgress: Pending inventory made no verified progress. Instruction unsent.

references.finishEditing: Finish attachment editing before sending. Instruction unsent.
references.unresolved: An attachment outcome is unresolved. Reconcile it in this Runner before sending; instruction unsent.
